title: End-to-End Testing with Playwright
description: Simulate real user flows across multiple pages and catch integration bugs before they reach production.

slides.title: Beyond Unit Tests 🌐
slides.content:
# Testing the Whole App

Unit tests verify pieces in isolation. End‑to‑end (E2E) tests simulate a real browser environment:

* Clicking navigation links.
* Filling and submitting forms.
* Checking that the correct page content appears.

**Playwright** is a powerful E2E testing tool from Microsoft that supports Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

quizData.question: What is the key difference between Playwright and Jest?

options.text: Jest is for unit/integration tests; Playwright is for browser‑based E2E tests

quizData.explanation: Jest runs in Node.js (simulated DOM). Playwright controls real browsers, testing the full stack from user perspective.

slides.title: First E2E Test: Homepage Loads (tests/home.spec.js)
slides.content: Navigate to the homepage and check the title.

slides.title: Testing User Flows 🧑‍💻
slides.content:
# Simulating Navigation & Forms

Playwright's API is intuitive:

* `page.click('text=About')` – click a link.
* `page.fill('input[name="email"]', 'test@example.com')` – type into fields.
* `page.click('button[type="submit"]')` – submit.
* `page.waitForURL('**/thank-you')` – wait for navigation.

You can test the entire journey from login to dashboard.

slides.title: Form Submission Test (tests/feedback.spec.js)
slides.content: Fill out a feedback form and verify success message.

quizData.question: What does `expect(page.locator('.success')).toHaveText('Thanks!')` do?

options.text: Checks that the element contains any text
Waits for the element to appear and verifies its exact text content is 'Thanks!'
Immediately fails if the element is not in the DOM
Sets the text of the element

quizData.explanation: Playwright's `toHaveText` assertion waits for the locator to be visible and have the exact text, making tests robust against async updates.

slides.title: Debugging Failed Tests 🐞
slides.content:
# Playwright Superpowers

* **Trace Viewer**: `npx playwright show-trace test-results/...` – see a timeline, screenshots, DOM snapshot.
* **UI Mode**: `npx playwright test --ui` – interactive test runner.
* **Codegen**: `npx playwright codegen` – record actions and generate test code.
* **Screenshots & Videos**: automatically captured on failure.

These tools turn headless failures into debuggable stories.

slides.title: Integration with CI/CD 🚀
slides.content: Run Playwright tests on every PR using GitHub Actions. Vercel preview deployments provide a unique URL to test against. This ensures no visual regression slips through.
